policy: FAIL_CLOSED: only APPROVED records with official source/license evidence may enter production recommendation pool.

naver.name: NAVER 한글한글 아름답게
naver.basis: Official page states free use for individuals/companies, commercial use allowed except paid standalone font sale; modification/redistribution allowed. Maru Buri and Clova handwriting follow same open-license rules.

baemin.name: Woowa Brothers / Baemin Fonts
baemin.basis: Official license explicitly allows commercial/noncommercial use, modification, web, ads, goods, logos/marks; standalone OTF/TTF sale prohibited; SIL OFL 1.1.

pretendard.name: Pretendard
pretendard.basis: SIL OFL 1.1; official README permits commercial use, modification and redistribution except standalone font sale.

suit.name: SUIT
suit.basis: SIL OFL 1.1; official project permits use, modification and redistribution.

wanted.name: Wanted Sans
wanted.basis: SIL OFL; official README permits commercial use, modification and redistribution except standalone sale/license change.

spoqa.name: Spoqa Han Sans Neo
spoqa.basis: SIL OFL; official README explicitly permits commercial logo/BI/CI/embed and modification/redistribution.

gmarket.name: Gmarket Sans
gmarket.basis: Official Gmarket page states SIL OFL and free commercial/noncommercial use.

line.name: LINE Seed Sans KR
line.basis: Official LINE Seed page states SIL OFL 1.1 and free personal/commercial use; standalone font-file sale prohibited.

d2.name: D2Coding
d2.basis: SIL OFL 1.1; official repository permits use and redistribution including bundling with commercial software.

cafe24.name: Cafe24 Fonts
cafe24.basis: Official site positions the collection as commercial-use free fonts, but crawler-visible official text does not expose detailed modification/redistribution/vector-output terms. Keep out of production until detailed license terms are captured.

reviewCollections.name: Cafe24 Korean Fonts
reviewCollections.reason: Official site is clearly a commercial-use free font service, but current crawler-visible page does not expose detailed license clauses needed for fail-closed approval of modification/SVG path/font redistribution.
